note: Shows choosing melodies by filter: each melody-singer names a difficulty and a stage with pick instead of a tune number, the second a step harder than the first. The text describes the kind of tune, then walks the app: hear it, start the mic, watch the staff.

exercise.title: Two tunes: steps, then skips
exercise.focus: An easy Do Re Mi tune, then a medium Do Mi Sol tune in D
exercise.why: Tunes that move by step are the easiest to sing in tune, so they come before tunes that skip.

sections.text: A tune on Do, Re and Mi. Press Play to hear it, then start the mic and sing it on the note names; your pitch shows on the staff as you go. Once it feels easy, switch to "la" and try singing it before you hear it.

A longer tune that skips through Do, Mi and Sol, now in D: Do is D instead of G, and the names keep their sound. Look at the staff first and guess how it goes. Press Play to check your guess, then start the mic and sing it on "la".
